name: Floating card field
description: Rounded cards at three blur depths drifting, with a caption in the middle; at the end they fly outward past camera.

recipe.build: 8-12 absolutely positioned cards, filter:blur(0/4/10), scale by depth, slow translate loops; at the end all cards fly outward.

use_when: Crowds of choice, outputs, a sea of content.
avoid: Do not add more than 12 cards; keep the caption fixed.
